spot.name: Marlborough Sounds
spot.notes: Huge area of protected waterways. Blue cod stronghold.
spot.facing_note: Sounds are sheltered; bearing is the outer Cook Strait entrance

verdict.headline: Go Tue 6-9pm
verdict.advice: Tue 6-9pm, light E 3 kn, 0.3 m sea @ 6 s, rising tide, dusk - try snapper: soft-baits or berleyed baits along reef edges and work-ups

species.name: Snapper
species.how: soft-baits or berleyed baits along reef edges and work-ups
notes: sea 14.2 C is below the ~14.8 C where snapper start spawning inshore
Inshore spawning aggregations Oct-Mar, peak Nov-Dec; spawning starts at roughly 14.8-16 C sea temperature.
sources: Parsons et al. 2014, 'Snapper (Chrysophrys auratus): a review of life history and key vulnerabilities in New Zealand', NZ J Marine & Freshwater Research 48(2). https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/00288330.2014.892013
NIWA: spring spawning migrations at about 16 C. https://niwa.co.nz/news/will-it-be-fintastic-fishing-year
